# f5xc_network_policy_rule (Data Source)

NetworkPolicyRule data source

The `f5xc_network_policy_rule` data source allows you to retrieve information about an existing configuration within your F5 XC tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "f5xc_network_policy_rule" "example" {
  namespace = "example_namespace"
  name      = "example_network_policy_rule"
}
```

## Schema

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) name This is the name of configuration object. It has to be unique within the namespace. It can only be specified during create API and cannot be changed during replace API. The value of name has to follow DNS-1035 format.
- `namespace` (String) namespace This defines the workspace within which each the configuration object is to be created. Must be a DNS_LABEL format. For a namespace object itself, namespace value will be ''
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `action` (List of String) Action Action to be taken at rule match. Currently supported actions are Allow and  Deny
- `advanced_action` (Attributes) advanced_action Enable or disable logging. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--advanced_action))
- `annotations` (Map of String) annotations Annotations is an unstructured key value map stored with a resource that may be set by external tools to store and retrieve arbitrary metadata. They are not queryable and should be preserved when modifying objects.
- `description` (String) description Human readable description for the object
- `label_matcher` (Attributes) label matcher List of label keys to be matched in prefix_selector configured in remote_endpoint (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--label_matcher))
- `labels` (Map of String) labels Map of string keys and values that can be used to organize and categorize (scope and select) objects as chosen by the user. Values specified here will be used by selector expression
- `ports` (List of String) ports List of port ranges. Each range is a single port or a pair of start and end ports e.g. 8080-8192
- `protocol` (String) protocol Protocol in IP packet to be used as match criteria Values are tcp, udp, and icmp
- `remote_endpoint_choice` (Attributes) Remote Endpoint Remote endpoint is the other endpoint for ingress or egress session with local endpoint of network policy. If network policy rule is a ingress rule in network policy then remote endpoint indicates the source endpoint from  which session is initiated. If network policy rule is a egress rule in network policy then remote endpoint indicates the destination endpoint to which session is initiated. Not specifying any endpoint will result in creation of ANY endpoint (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--remote_endpoint_choice))
- `uid` (String) uid uid is the unique in time and space value for this object. Object create will fail if provided by the client and the value exists in the system. Typically generated by the server on successful creation of an object and is not allowed to change once populated. Shadowed by SystemObjectMeta's uid field.
